rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for an insect, machine, or other thing making a continuous buzzing or humming sound.

example.english: I can hear the air conditioner next door buzz nonstop, and I can't sleep.
example.traditional: 隔離部冷氣一路嗡，我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 bou6 laang5 hei3 jat1 lou6 jung1 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a rush or feeling of excitement, including the effect of coffee.

example.english: After finishing the coffee, I had a buzz.
example.traditional: 飲完杯咖啡，成個人都有興奮感。
example.jyutping: jam2 jyun4 bui1 gaa3 fe1 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 hing1 fan5 gam2

rows.traditional: 成個 + N + 都 + 好熱鬧
rows.jyutping: sing4 go3 N dou1 hou2 jit6 naau6
rows.note: Use this when a place or event is lively and full of activity, haste, or excitement rather than literally making a buzzing sound.

example.english: On Friday nights, the whole bar can buzz with activity.
example.traditional: 一到星期五晚，成個酒吧都好熱鬧。
example.jyutping: jat1 dou3 sing1 kei4 ng5 maan5 sing4 go3 zau2 baa1 dou1 hou2 jit6 naau6

rows.note: Use this for the telephone-call slice of the sense, especially in expressions meaning “give me a call”; it does not specifically mean an email.

example.english: Give me a buzz when you have time.
example.jyutping: dak1 haan4 daa2 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Choose this when the buzz is a rumour or information circulating behind the scenes rather than simply a hot topic.

example.english: I heard a buzz that the company will lay people off next month.
example.traditional: 我聽到風聲，話公司下個月會裁員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 fung1 sing1 waa6 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 coi4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this specifically when an insect or object flies while making a buzzing sound.

example.english: A bee can buzz as it flies by my ear, and it really annoys me.
example.traditional: 隻蜜蜂喺我耳仔邊嗡住飛，搞到我好煩。
example.jyutping: zek3 mat6 fung1 hai2 ngo5 ji5 zai2 bin1 jung1 zyu6 fei1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 faan4

rows.note: Use this for a continuous humming or buzzing noise, especially from insects or machinery.

example.english: The air conditioner is making a constant buzz.
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 faat3 ceot1 jung1 jung1 sing1

rows.note: Use this for people chatting about an interesting topic, with the excitedness supplied by the context.

example.english: We got a real buzz chatting about the new game all night.
example.traditional: 我哋圍住隻新驚傾偈，成晚都停唔到口。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wai4 zyu6 zek3 san1 geng1 king1 gai2 sing4 maan5 dou1 ting4 m4 dou3 hau2
